blocks.text: The AI Guard Token Usage dashboard provides an overview of the data usage by users.
The AI Guard Token Usage page provides the following benefits and enables you to:

blocks.item: View general statistics about AI Guard token usage by users.
View usage based on specific time intervals.

blocks.heading: About the AI Guard Token Usage Page

blocks.text: On the AI Guard Token Usage page (AI Guard > Token Usage), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Select the date range for your data.
Refresh updates your dashboard with the most current data.
Select to view token usage data across the entire tenant, or a single user
The Overview section shows the following information:
Total Tokens: All prompt and response tokens used by every user in your tenant during this period.
Top User: The user that used the most tokens.
Busiest Day: The day with the most token usage.
Avg. per User: Average tokens used by each user on the leaderboard. A high "Top User" share with a low average means usage is concentrated in a few users.
The Insights section presents the following data:
Prompts vs. Responses: Total number of prompts and transactions as well as their ratio.
Activity by day & hour: Requires Hourly or 5-min granularity to see hour-of-day patterns.
Token Consumption: A graph of token consumption over the selected time period.
LLM Provider Distribution: See LLM distribution information based on the level of granularity you have selected (Daily, Hourly, 5-min).
Top users by token usage: The 10 users that used the most tokens. Click a bar to filter the page to just that user.
Raw Data: A quick total summary of prompts and responses by date. Data can be exported.
